title: Subjective and objective genitives
subtitle: Ask who performs and who receives the noun’s action.
overview: With an action noun, a genitive may name the doer (subjective) or the receiver/object (objective).
Grammar alone does not always settle the question. State the alternatives, then let immediate and larger context guide a careful reading.

sections.title: Two possible roles
rows: God’s love / love for God, context decides

items.grc: ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκκέχυται ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν.
items.en: The love of God has been poured into our hearts; context must clarify the relation.
The obedience of faith; identify the relation before choosing a full English wording.
